Overview

About me

A quick look at who I am and the work I do.

I'm a Business Analyst in the Product department at EaseToLearn, turning user and business data into product decisions — from tracking plans and requirements to dashboards and automation.

I joined as an intern in October 2025 and moved into a full-time role in April 2026. Day to day, I partner with engineering on event tracking across the website and mobile apps, build reporting in Amplitude, GA4, Looker Studio and Power BI, and document requirements for features on the student and teacher app platform.

I also automate repetitive sales and marketing workflows with n8n, saving each sales executive about an hour of manual work a week. I'm now looking for a Product Analyst / Business Analyst role where I can combine product thinking, analytics and delivery.
